statement: Between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-12, UKMTO publishes at least one incident advisory reporting a merchant vessel struck, attacked, or boarded in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman.
resolution: TRUE if the UKMTO incident advisory list carries at least one entry with an incident date between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-12 placing a vessel attack in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel is struck, attacked, or boarded in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman during the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-15, NATO announces Article 4 consultations convened at the request of Poland following a Russian strike, drone incursion, or airspace violation affecting Polish territory.
resolution: TRUE if a NATO press release or official statement confirms Article 4 consultations requested by Poland over an incident occurring between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-15.
failure_condition: Poland does not request Article 4 consultations over an incident falling inside the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude futures settle at or above 120.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 104.61 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the ICE published settlement for the front-month Brent contract equals or exceeds 120.00 USD on any trading day in the window. Reference level 104.61 on 2026-09-13.
failure_condition: Every front-month Brent settlement inside the window stays below 120.00 USD per barrel.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: FRED series DGS10 records a value of 5.25 percent or higher on at least one business day between 2026-09-14 and 2026-12-15. Reference: 4.97 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if any DGS10 observation dated between 2026-09-14 and 2026-12-15 is greater than or equal to 5.25. Reference level 4.97 percent on 2026-09-13.
failure_condition: The 10-year constant maturity yield stays below 5.25 percent on every business day in the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class

resolution: TRUE if any official S&P 500 daily close inside the window is less than or equal to 7000.00. Reference level 7656.98 at the 2026-09-13 close.
failure_condition: Every S&P 500 daily close inside the window stays above 7000.00.

failure_condition: No prime ministerial candidate survives a Riksdag vote before 2026-12-05.

resolution: TRUE if Congress.gov lists a public law enacted inside the window authorizing per-person payments of 5000 USD or more characterized as a dividend or rebate.
